name: Primalist Journey to the Core delayed fixed ground and proc rate
contract: One hundred first/highest Tremor direct hits and separate native periodic ticks sample 20% Crag generation. Each proc produces one burst after three seconds. Moving away avoids it; the ground burst hits at most five of six enemies and grants only its caster 20% Earthquake damage for five seconds. Native SP/Nature coefficients add 100% and AP adds nothing. The coefficient probes query the unhit creature 'outside', so normal class 887019 (-15%) and Geomancy 887086 (+23%) tuning multiply them by 1.0455: the SP increases of 71-73 and 65-67 before tuning read 74-76 and 68-70.
